question: Is 308 Evergreen Street on a septic system or connected to city sewer?
why_it_matters: Determines whether TDEC process applies (42-day lead, $500 fee, soil scientist site visit) and whether it gates the excavation start; see fact job_septic_tdec_requirement.

question: Has TDEC been contacted yet to initiate the septic evaluation process?
why_it_matters: With a 2026-10-12 on-site start, TDEC's 42-calendar-day process must begin by ~2026-08-31; today is 2026-07-14 leaving ~48 days — inaction now risks pushing the start date.

question: Is the tankless water heater in the contracted scope, or is the breakdown the 'with tankless WH option' version that was not selected?
why_it_matters: The scope PDF describes only extending the existing gas WH vent; the breakdown CSV header explicitly says 'Incl. Tankless WH Option' — if a new tankless WH is in scope, it triggers tank_set sequencing and a 7–14 day procurement lead; see fact job_water_heater_scope.

question: Has the existing main electrical service amperage been verified to support the new 100A subpanel without a service upgrade?
why_it_matters: Scope explicitly states this is an assumption (fact job_electrical_subpanel); if the main service is undersized, a service upgrade adds scope, cost, and a separate permit pull — catching this now avoids a mid-job change order.

question: Is there an engineered detail or drawing for the 3/12-into-6/12 roof tie-in, or will concealed rafter conditions be discovered during framing?
why_it_matters: This pitch transition is a known change-order risk for additions — existing rafter sizing may not accept new loads; no saddle detail is visible in the A-01/A-02 drawing set per DRAWINGS.pdf.

question: The architectural drawings (A-02) show a multi-level deck and stair system on the addition exterior — is this in scope and priced in the breakdown?
why_it_matters: Neither the scope PDF nor any breakdown section explicitly calls out deck or stair construction; if the deck is in scope, it represents a significant omission in the cost breakdown; see fact job_drawings_deck_callout.

question: Given the Oct 12 start, foundation and framing will run through November 2026 — has the schedule been buffered for weather delays that could push exterior work into the mid-Dec to mid-Feb weather-sensitive window?
why_it_matters: TCR's own CLAUDE.md flags mid-Dec through mid-Feb as weather-risky for foundation and framing; a 10–16 week addition timeline from Oct 12 projects completion between late December 2026 and February 2027; see belief winter_timeline_risk.

question: Are the 4 specified windows (three 36"x60" + one transom) stock or custom units?
why_it_matters: Stock windows carry a 14–21 day supplier lead while custom carry 28–42 days; with an Oct 12 start, procurement timing differs by up to 3 weeks and must be locked before permit submittal; see fact job_exterior_openings.

question: Has the roof framing method been decided — stick-frame or trusses?
why_it_matters: Scope lists this as TBD in design phase (fact job_roof_pitch_and_framing_method); trusses require a 28–42 day procurement lead that must be ordered at structural sign-off; stick-frame requires no procurement task.

question: Is the negative section total (-$1,714.20) on 'Existing Hall Bath Mod, Bedroom Remodel & Closeout' a credit/scope reduction or a data entry error?
why_it_matters: The section carries 72 labor hours but a -$4,199 material figure driving a negative total; negative material on an active 72-hour scope section is unusual and needs PM confirmation before scheduling; see fact job_hall_bath_negative_section.

question: Drawings call out 'ADD BRICK TO MATCH EXISTING' at the base of the addition — is this brick veneer priced in the breakdown, and if so, in which section?
why_it_matters: No masonry or brick section appears in the 16-row breakdown; if brick veneer is in the drawings and not in the cost breakdown, it is an unpriced scope item; see fact job_drawings_deck_callout.

question: Is the 3-ply 14" LVL beam a standard stock item or pressure-treated/custom — and has it been ordered or quoted?
why_it_matters: Standard LVL carries a 14-day safety lead; pressure-treated or custom carries 21 days; with an Oct 12 start the LVL order must be placed at structural sign-off and the spec affects when that trigger fires; see fact job_lvl_beam_spec.
